_help: HAND-MAINTAINED. 'pnpm scrape' never writes this file.
Stops across the road from each other that the feed doesn't link. The
scrape pairs 'X' with 'X-OPP' and 'Opp X' with 'X'; a pair with unrelated
names needs listing here. Each pair is two stop codes, one per direction
of travel. A listed pair replaces whatever either stop was paired with.
'nearby' pairs are only for the Nearby widget's swap button: stops near
enough for a location to put you at the wrong one, but too far apart for
routing to treat them as one stop (PGP and PGP Foyer, 118 m).
